title: Liability for defective products
verbatim_text: The manufacturer of a product shall be liable to a consumer for damages proximately caused by a characteristic of the product that renders the product defective when such damage arose from a reasonably anticipated use of the product.
source_citation: Official Gazette / Lahore High Court / Pakistan Code, Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005

title: Filing of claims before Consumer Court (15-Day Written Notice)
verbatim_text: (1) A consumer who has suffered damage, or an authority on behalf of consumers, may file a claim before the Consumer Court having territorial jurisdiction: Provided that the consumer shall first give a written notice of fifteen days to the manufacturer or service provider.
provisos: Provided that the consumer shall first give a written notice of fifteen days to the manufacturer or service provider.
source_citation: Official Gazette / Lahore High Court / Pakistan Code, Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005
